translation.name: Iwaperite tajorentsi ikenkithatakoetziri awinkatharite Jesokirishito: owakirari inimotakiri tajorentsi

book.name: ROÑAAGAYITAKIRINI
book.title: ROÑAAGAYITAKIRINI JESOSHI JOWA OETARIKAPAENI AWIJATSINI IINJA OTHONKANTAPAAKYAARI KIPATSI

content: Ari koñaatziro noñaakiro eejatzi, noñaakiro rakoperoki Tajorentsi rapineeteetakiro Iwaperite, ojankinataka inthomaenta eejatzi jakakiroka. Ari apineekaka eejatzi ontsirekaka kameetha, okaataki 7.
Eejatzi noñaakiri ronampiri Tajorentsi, shintsitaperotatsiri, itacheronkawaantetapaaki ikantawita: —¿Ninka kameethaperotatsiri imatantyaawori riyontareero iroka jankinarentsika, rapineereero?
Ari namineeyawitanakani, tekatsi akirini. Tekatsi materoni rapineereero. Tee imatziro jenokijatzi, kipatsijatzi, jeekatsiri tsikarikapaeni. Tekatsikya.
Tekatsi apaani kameethaperotatsini, mataperoterorini rapineereero, rootaki netakoperotantanakari: kyaaryo niraakoperotanakari, tekatsi kamantenawoni oeta okantakotayitzirini jankinarentsi.

Roojatzi ikantakina apaani aataperoteenchari: —Eero piraaga. Eenitatsi apineeryagaeroni: riraga icharineeteni Joraani; ikimiwitakari chaanari, osheki ishintsitzi. Eejatzi rirotaki icharinetakarini Iraviiri, tema osheki ipinkatharitzi. Imatakiniri Tajorentsi maawaeni ikowakagaeyakiririni, rootaki imatanteeyaworini riyontaryagaero eejatzi rapineereero Iwaperite.

Roojatzi naminakotziri Tajorentsi janta iwinkatharimentoki, eejatzi ikaatzi ronampiri kameethari 4, eejatzi riraga 24 aataperoteenchari. Eejatzi noñaakiri rojatekaka niyanki inewootziri Tajorentsi riraga Jesoshi iiteetziri Rowishate. Noñaakiri rakoki imoontawaetaka eejatzi iitziki rowamaanteetakariri paerani. Eenitatsi ichee 7, eejatzi roki 7: oshiyakaawentziro riraga 7 ronampiri Tajorentsi jewawenantatsiri rotyaantakiri ithotyaakiro raminiri maawaeni atziri jaka kipatsikika.
Ari riyaatashitakiri Tajorentsi roerikakiro rakoperoki Iwaperite, apineekachari.

Roojatzi roerikantapaakawo, riraga 4 ronampiri omampaawaetapiintachari eejatzi riraga aataperoteencharipaeni rotziwerowashiteeyakarini riraga Rowishate Tajorentsi. Roerikaeyakironi kimitawitawori aaripa; roerikaeyakironi eejatzi kimitawitawori pajo, riwetsikaetziri ooro: ojeekaki inthomaenta kajankapaneri. Iroka kajankapanerika oshiyakawo amanaantsipaeni aapatziyeeyaririni Tajorentsi.
Roojatzi romampaawenteeyantakarini Rowishate Tajorentsi mampaantsi owakirari. Romampaawentakari iroka:

content.text: Tema paerani rowamagaetakimi, papaatawenteeyakinawoni piraa naakapaeni maawaeni atziripaeni, pipinawentakinawo okaatzi nanteeyirini.
Powawijaakoeyakirini jeekayitatsirini maawaeni inashitzinkaripaeni atziri, inashitayitaworini maawaeni ipaantepaeni.
Kyaaryo, powawijaakoeyakinani poñaayitacharini maawaeni nampitsikipaeni, tsikarika nojeekayitzini.
rootaki iinja nopinkathariwenanteeyaarini maawaeni paashinipaeni jeekatsiripaeni kipatsiki, tema namanakowenanteeyaaririni ramitakoeyerini Piri.
Rootaki pimatantawori pagaero eeroka Iwaperite Tajorentsi,

content: Roojatzi naminantanaa eejatzi; noñeeyakirini riraga osheki ronampiripaeni Tajorentsi: tee apaanipaeni ikanta, oshekiperoroña kameetha. Eejatzi noñeeyakirini eejatzi riraga 4 ronampiri kameethari eejatzi riraga 24 aataperoteenchari.

content.text: “Osheki ikameethaperotaki Jesoshi iiteetziri Rowishate Tajorentsi rowamagaetawitakari, riyoteeyakini maawaeni jeekaeyatsirini
osheki itajorentsitaki rirori, rashiteeyakawoni maawaeni oetarikapaeni,
osheki riyotziro oetarikapaeni, maawaeni imatayitakironi oetarikapaeni.

content: Eejatzi nokemaeyakirini maawaeni jeekatsiripaeni jenokinta, eejatzi kipatsiki, eejatzi maawaeni kamaeyawiteencharini: riraga kitatawiteenchari kipatsiki, eejatzi piinkawitachari; romampaawenteeyakarini maawaeni kameetha:

content.text: “Thame maawaeni aweshiryaawenteeyaarini Tajorentsi jeekatsiri iwinkatharimentoki eejatzi Rowishate,

content: Eejatzi rotziwerowashiteeyakarini riraga aataperoteencharipaeni ipinkathateeyakirini maawaeni.
